newsitem.title: UK: Sterling/mark nudges up to new high after UK data.
newsitem.headline: Sterling/mark nudges up to new high after UK data.

text.p: 0905 GMT - Stg/mark nudges up to new 59-month of 2.8950 as stronger-than-expected UK data fans rate rise hopes. Pound's trade-weighted index up to 102 vs 101.8 Friday.
* Stg/mark at 2.8948/57 vs 2.8885/95 before data, 2.8885/95 late Friday in Europe. Cable at $1.6626/36 from $1.6615/25 before economic reports and $1.6614/24 Friday.
* UK consumer credit up s/a 1.105 bln stg in May vs expected rise of 900 million stg. May increase revised up to 806 million vs initial estimate of 691 million.
* June M0 money supply up s/a 1.0 pct m/m, 6.3 pct y/y vs 0.5 m/m, 6.0 pct y/y rise in May.
* Final May M4 rise revised to 1.4 m/m from prior estimate of 1.3 pct increase, y/y rise unchanged at 11.1 pct.
* UK budget Wednesday seen moving to curb consumer spending. Brown expected to cut tax break on mortgage interest payments (MIRAS) to 10 pct from 15 pct, according to Sunday newspapers.
